content:
Nora Patel: Hi all, quick onboarding glitch. I completed Okta but a 1Password invite went to my personal nora.patel+jobs@gmail.com instead of nora@redwood.com, and when I try to register a passkey on my Mac it errors with "NotAllowedError". Also Okta shows two identities for me (one with +jobs). Anyone seen this?
Raj (People Ops): Welcome Nora! :wave: DM me the personal address and I'll remove it from HR record and resend invites.
Nora Patel: DM sent. Thanks.
IT Support: Created ticket ONB-9912. Quick diagnostics: are you using Safari or Chrome, and did you accept any invites from your phone earlier?
Nora Patel: Safari 16.5 on macOS 13.5 and I tapped the invite on my phone earlier (iPhone).
Maria (IT): That explains the passkey hiccup sometimestap from phone can create a platform credential tied to AppleID. We'll remove the alt email and ask you to re-enroll. Raj, can you remove the +jobs alias from HR?
Raj (People Ops): Removed at 1965551255 and resent 1Password to nora@redwood.com.
oncall-bot: [ONB-9912] Ticket created and assigned to Maria (IT).
Nora Patel: Got the 1Password invite to work email. Thanks. Still getting NotAllowedError when I try to add a passkey in Safari System Settings though.
Maria (IT): Two quick checks: 1) In System Settings -> Passwords, is "Allow websites to use passkeys" enabled? 2) Did you accept the invite on iPhone; if yes, try removing that credential from iCloud Keychain first.
Nora Patel: Option was off. Turned it on at 1965551305 and removed the iCloud credential. Reattempting...
Nora Patel: Success at 1965551330passkey enrolled in System Settings. 1Password team vault accessible now too.
DevEx - Priya: For future YubiKey users: if a HW key fails during enrollment, try Chrome (sometimes Safari blocks U2F), and ensure firmware is FIDO2. We can also force a provisioning resync if group vaults don't appear.
IT Support: Marking ONB-9912 resolved. Reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
